comment: The installed build is 2.0.1 and the repository's plugin.json never got past 2.0.0, so no commit carries the installed version. Read at 36bf491, the tip of main. The last commit to touch any source file is 367dc3f, which changed the model slug from InfrasonicAudio-WarpCore to WarpCore; the installed manifest uses the short slug and the string InfrasonicAudio-WarpCore does not appear in the installed build, so the build is at or after that commit, and everything after it is documentation. Each configInput and configOutput is called once with its own enum. Two parameters share one panel position: INT PM at index 1 and the PM Ratio knob at index 10 are both created at 48.465, 22.829mm, and the widget shows one and hides the other according to the Edit Internal PM Ratio menu item, so both are real controls at different times and both are tagged. Widget order otherwise follows enum order except that the PM Ratio knob is added last, after the two switches. Four things worth checking against the maker's manual. The manual gives the tuning range as 32.7Hz to 2646.4Hz; configParam sets five octaves over a 32.7Hz base, which is 1046.4Hz, and the note name C6 the manual also gives agrees with the code rather than with its own figure. The constructor calls setRatioIndex(8), which is 1 to 1, but process() overwrites the ratio from the PM Ratio parameter on every block and that parameter's default is 3, so a fresh module actually starts at the 3 to 2 ratio. The window switch's three positions map through WIN_TYPE_LAST - 1 - value, so the top position is Off and the module comes up with no windowing. And the algorithm the manual and menu call Pinch is PD_TYPE_FORMANT in the code. The eight lights sit in four BlueRedLight widgets and are not ParamWidgets, so they get a Note rather than lines. Oversampling defaults to 4x in SampleRateConfig.
